title: Effects of one night of sleep deprivation on single- and dual-task gait

abstract_extraction.primary_outcome: gait parameters (spatio-temporal parameters, foot placement error, and mediolateral margin of stability)
abstract_extraction.direction_summary: Declined: SDEP increased step time and length, altered foot placement error, and decreased mediolateral margin of stability.
abstract_extraction.evidence: Additionally, mean MoS ML decreased only in SDEP ( p = 0.025).

body_extraction.primary_outcome: biomechanical gait control measures (spatio-temporal parameters, foot placement control, and mediolateral margins of stability)
body_extraction.direction_summary: Declined stability (reduced mean MoS ML) and altered gait parameters under sleep deprivation.
body_extraction.evidence: These results suggest that SDEP subtly decreases stability, whereas cognitive load reduced variability without changing the average MoS ML.
